name: Tom Gigler
headline: Platform Engineering Manager
summary: Platform engineering leader with more than two decades of experience building and improving developer infrastructure, build and release systems, source-control workflows, CI/CD platforms, and internal engineering tools. Progressed from hands-on build engineering through technical leadership into engineering management while remaining closely involved in the design and operation of the systems used by development teams.

experience.title: Platform Engineering Manager
bullets: Lead a platform engineering team responsible for developer infrastructure and engineering productivity across build, CI/CD, artifact management, and source control.
Support engineering workflows built around Git, GitHub Enterprise, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, artifact management, package management, and internal developer tooling.
Emphasize durable ownership within the team so engineers can lead systems, onboard others, and make decisions without unnecessary management bottlenecks.

experience.title: Build Engineer → Senior Build Engineer → Lead Build Engineer
bullets: Built and maintained release and build systems for major software products across Windows and Unix-like environments.
Designed dependency and build tooling that simplified large, interdependent codebases and materially reduced build time.
Worked across development, QA, release engineering, and infrastructure teams to improve reliability, repeatability, and developer experience.

projects.name: GiggleCheckBox
projects.description: Reusable checklist system built around templates, runs, locations, assets, dependencies, tags, attachments, and auditable checklist activity.

projects.name: GiggleMe
projects.description: Long-running Discord automation project with scheduled content, templates, database-backed workflows, web tooling, and service-based deployment.
